purpose: Resolve the two declared PH-R00 validation failures without importing quarantined capability, changing runtime behavior, starting PH-D00A, or accessing an official environment.

resolved_requirements.root_cause: The historical runtime allowlist retained unreachable infrastructure modules, including p_bundle.py, whose compiled_policy import made the package closure incomplete.
resolved_requirements.correction: Define four GenericAGIRuntime entry modules, require the allowlist to equal their exact statically reachable local import closure, and fail closed on missing, extraneous, duplicate, or quarantined modules.
evidence: 19 of 19 dedicated notebook and rev3 tests pass
37 reachable runtime modules and zero quarantined intersections

resolved_requirements.root_cause: The project virtual environment did not contain a package build frontend.
resolved_requirements.correction: Use an ephemeral unmanaged uv 0.11.32 installation outside the repository, verify uv.lock before and after the build, fix SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH to the result commit timestamp, and inspect two independently built wheels.
evidence: uv lock --check resolves 124 packages with CPython 3.12.13
wheel metadata is arc-agi-3-agents 0.1.0 with py3-none-any tag
wheel has 240 members, includes rev3_governance.py, and excludes tests

non_blocking_execution_incidents.symptom: The first full-unit attempt reported 673 passed and 13 setup errors under the Windows global pytest temp root.
non_blocking_execution_incidents.cause: PermissionError [WinError 5] on the global pytest temp root.

non_blocking_execution_incidents.symptom: The first foreground integration command exceeded the 180-second tool-call limit after 6 of 8 tests.
non_blocking_execution_incidents.cause: Tool-call duration limit, not a test assertion failure.
non_blocking_execution_incidents.correction: Run the same suite as a monitored process with a repository-local --basetemp.

claim.allowed: PH-R00 validation rework implemented, tested, and evidence generated
